shortBio.en: The Clash vocals/guitar; punk urgency plus reggae/rockabilly range on London Calling–era records.
shortBio.zh: The Clash 人声/吉他；朋克紧迫感加上 London Calling 时期的 reggae/rockabilly 幅度。

whyHub.en: Frontman as curator of styles: political bark and genre tourism held in one Clash catalog.
whyHub.zh: 主唱即风格策展：政治嘶吼与类型游历收在同一 Clash 目录。

body.en:
Born 1952. Joins The Clash 1976 with Jones, Simonon; Headon locks drums later. White Riot–era singles are UK punk citations; London Calling (1979) and Sandinista! expand into dub, soul, and rockabilly without dropping the barked vocal.

Jones exits 1983; band ends mid-80s. Later Mescaleros work continues the songwriter role outside the Clash logo. Hub: vocal personality as the constant across style jumps.
body.zh:
1952 年生。1976 与 Jones、Simonon 加入 The Clash；其后 Headon 锁定鼓。White Riot 时期单曲是英国朋克引用；London Calling（1979）与 Sandinista! 扩入 dub、soul、rockabilly，吼叫人声不丢。

Jones 1983 离队；乐队 80 年代中解散。后 Mescaleros 在 Clash logo 外延续写手角色。枢纽：风格跳跃中人声个性是常量。

note.en: Founding vocals/guitar through London Calling peak.
note.zh: 创始人声/吉他，贯穿 London Calling 巅峰。

note.en: Late songwriter vehicle; project not yet in chronicle.
note.zh: 后期写手载体；项目尚未入编年史。
